summary: Implemented the `rotate` command (new logkeep/rotate.py and logkeep/policy.py, time parsing in dates.py, CLI wiring in cli.py) following docs/rotate.md and docs/policy.md. The unit tests pass, and a run on a copy of /app/data behaved as the docs describe. For a dated stream whose day already has archives I used one more than the highest K in use (the existing test expects .4 for K values 1 and 3), where rotate.md's wording would give the lowest unused K from 2.
